title: Check every dependency against Angular 22
goal: Each dependency's Angular 22 support is known before the upgrade
acceptance: The record lists, for TypeScript, @angular/build with Vitest and jsdom, angular-eslint, Tailwind 4 through PostCSS and @runanywhere/web*, the version that supports Angular 22 (from its peer dependencies) or that it has no Angular coupling
Any blocker goes to the owner before F-007-T02
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A dependency with no Angular 22 support, or a material effort increase, goes to the owner before the upgrade continues

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: read peer dependencies with npm view; @runanywhere is the only unknown. Not a measurement.
